title: CUFP 2011 Keynote: Pragmatic Haskell (Lennart Augustsson Standard Chartered Bank)
summary: Lennart Augustsson's CUFP 2011 keynote covers using Haskell commercially at Standard Chartered Bank. He discusses non-standard Haskell implementations, including a strict dialect, and weighs strict against lazy evaluation.
why: It is the reference for Mu, Standard Chartered's strict Haskell, and for the practical case that strictness makes debugging easier.

quote.text: So strictness is really fantastic, I must say. Stack traces work.
